metadata.timing_method: Transform: first dispatch separately, then repeated steady-state calls including fresh output allocation. Auxiliary tasks/channels: internal total, including thread creation. Wall time includes process start/setup/cleanup. No memory sampling. C uses the same checked arithmetic, GC, and scheduler as Glyph; isolates frontend/lowering overhead, not an independent C scheduler. Python uses persistent ProcessPoolExecutor with chunksize=256; first includes process startup, steady includes serialization.
